videos.text: Men’s self-care goes beyond the haircut. 👏 From relaxing massages and rejuvenating facials to manicures, pedicures, and more, we offer services designed to help you look and feel your best from head to toe. 💆‍♂️✨ It’s time to make self-care part of your routine. Book your next appointment today! #menselfcare #GlowWithConfidence #kossofsalonspa #lincolnshire

It’s FarmHouse Friday! 🐄✨ Each week, we’re highlighting a new FarmHouse Fresh favorite and sharing the skincare education you need to know. From key ingredients to how to use each product, we’re here to help you find the right products for your skin. 🧴✨ Stay tuned for this week’s FarmHouse Fresh feature! 🤍

FarmHouse Friday is our weekly series where we highlight one of our favorite FarmHouse Fresh products and share what makes it special! 💚 We love taking a few minutes each week to help you learn more about skincare ingredients, how products work, and how to build a routine that keeps your skin healthy and glowing. This week we're featuring Super Lettuce™ Nourishing Facial Toner 🥬✨ Packed with lettuce, cucumber, aloe, green tea, and hyaluronic acid, it's the perfect way to refresh, hydrate, and soothe your skin after cleansing. @FarmHouse Fresh skincare  Have questions about your skincare routine? Stop by the salon—we're always happy to help you find the right products for your skin! 🌿 #FarmHouseFriday #FarmHouseFresh #SkincareEducation #HealthySkin #GlowWithConfidence

💨 Your skin isn't the only thing that needs protection from today's air quality—your hair does too. Smoke and pollution can leave hair feeling dry, dull, and weighed down. Using the right products helps shield your strands from environmental stress while keeping them healthy, hydrated, and full of shine. ✨ Need a recommendation? Stop by the salon or ask your stylist which products are best for your hair type. 🤍

Something new has arrived ✨️ We're excited to introduce Jane Iredale to Kossof Salon Spa! Clean skin-loving makeup that looks as good as it feels. Stop in to find your perfect match! 💄 #janeiredalemakeup #hairandspa #makeupartists #lincolnshire #kossofsalonspa

✨ FarmHouse Friday ✨ Say goodbye to stubborn makeup! 💛 Make It Melt effortlessly melts away makeup, SPF, and impurities while leaving your skin soft, hydrated, and glowing—never stripped. Stop by the salon to shop yours! 🌿🤍 #FarmHouseFriday #FarmHouseFresh #MakeItMelt #SkincareRoutine #KossofSalonSpa

✨ FarmHouse Fresh Friday ✨ Say goodbye to tired eyes! 👀💚 This week's spotlight is Eye'M Revived Eye Cream—the perfect pick-me-up for puffiness, dark circles, and dry under-eyes. Lightweight, hydrating, and packed with skin-loving ingredients, it's your secret to looking refreshed all summer long. Stop by the salon to try it or take one home! 💚 #FarmHouseFreshFriday #EyeMRevived #SkincareGlow #KossofSalonSpa

✨ Stars, Stripes & Smooth Hair! ✨  Our Summer Smoothing Special helps tame frizz, boost shine, and keep your hair looking its best—even in the summer humidity. Book your smoothing treatment and enjoy our limited-time holiday savings before they're gone! ❤️🤍💙

✨ FarmHouse Fresh Friday ✨ Say hello to your smoothest skin yet!  🌿💛 Our One Fine Day exfoliating face polish gently buffs away dull, dry skin to reveal a fresh, radiant glow—perfect for your weekly self-care routine. Stop by the salon to shop your FarmHouse Fresh favorites or order online and support our salon from the comfort of home! 🛍️✨ #FarmHouseFreshFriday #OneFineDay #GlowFromWithin #SkincareRoutine #ShopSmall
Hair days are better together 💇‍♀️💕 Grab your bestie, your daughter, your sister, or your mom and make it a salon day. Appointments are filling fast—reserve yours through the booking link in our bio!
Happy FarmHouse Fresh Friday! 🌿 Glow into the weekend with clean, nourishing skincare and a little extra pampering. ✨💗  #farmhousefresh #farmhousefriday  #spa #kossofsalonspa #lincolnshire
